BiblicalUsage: Meshiy is silk, the fine cloth drawn from the cocoon, and Ezekiel uses it to dress Jerusalem. Ezekiel 16:10 says God covered her with silk, and Ezekiel 16:13 says her raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe silk on Jerusalem is grace you can touch: God clothed the foundling in the finest cloth He had.
